checks: The three triangle inequalities and the nine-point box census give exactly four lattice sites with distinct parities. The product has 12·2^(n−3) equal unit fibers and 2^n occupied parity classes, so M/k(P)=3/2.

Equal parity forces agreement of the triangle coordinate and each binary padding coordinate. A distinct pair can therefore have an integral midpoint only through the 0,2 pair of the [0,2] coordinate. Those midpoint edges exist and φ=|b|² is constant along each.

At each fixed remaining coordinate, continuous point and normal, the origin's mass density two is sent as one to itself and one third to each vertex. Vertex density two thirds stays fixed. The result is unit target density with the correct full physical mean by the zero sum of the three vertices.

The three vertices are affinely independent and all support heights coincide, so the active three-point template is extreme. The vertex squared norms are 1,1,2. Each column contributes (4/3)·2d and summing the 3·2^(n−3) columns gives 8d·2^(n−3).

The pure-base cap margins sum to zero and at each nonzero triangle vertex exactly one is positive. At the origin all closed indicators equal one. Each cap contains exactly two of four triangle columns and hence has mixed fraction 1/2, and twice their average equals the source density.
